## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
ROTATION: Sector rotation, not risk-off. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND showing fear easing and HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.05%) / LQD (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -0.66%) RECOVERY signalling credit stress easing.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress easing: HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY and LQD (1W: +0.47% | 1M: -0.66%) RECOVERY. Fear declining: VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND; Stocks vs Bonds neutral to mixed with SPY (1W: +0.88% | 1M: +5.25%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -1.80%) RECOVERY.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-looser: Yield curve (1W: +1.32% | 1M: -1.73%) RECOVERY while duration preference flat; dollar strength elevated (Level up) supporting mixed FX/flow dynamics.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND and semis SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND. Financials/Cyclicals showing participation: XLF (1W: +1.91% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND while Materials XLB (1W: -0.02% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND — Style: Growth/momentum (tech/semis) leading.

**5. US vs Global?**
US leadership intact: SPY (1W: +0.88% | 1M: +5.25%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +10.15%) ABOVE TREND. EM mixed but recovering: EEM (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +5.66%) ABOVE TREND while China FXI (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation modestly elevated: IWM (1W: +2.71% | 1M: +3.48%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +2.00% | 1M: -0.13%) RECOVERY. Crypto reflation cooling: IBIT (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -2.47%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Industrial/reflation tone: CPER (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +5.30%) ABOVE TREND. Gold soft: GLD (1W: -0.83% | 1M: -3.99%) BELOW TREND, broad precious metals under pressure.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Mixed: XLE (1W: +0.08% | 1M: +4.41%) ABOVE TREND but front-month Brent BNO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +4.36%) in CORRECTION and natural gas UNG (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +3.99%) in CORRECTION — short-term oil/gas weakness within a reflation backdrop.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech/semis (XLK and SOXX) both 1W and 1M positive ABOVE TREND. MINOR divergence: TLT (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -1.80%) RECOVERY vs SPY ABOVE TREND — watch duration/credit cross-currents.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to tech/semiconductor ETFs (XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND; SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND) and selective cyclicals; reduce exposure to China/commodity-sensitive ETFs showing weakness (FXI (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND; XLB (1W: -0.02% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLB (1W: -0.02% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND and China plays FXI (1W: -1.88% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +2.05% | 1M: +5.30%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BNO (1W: -4.66% | 1M: +4.36%) CORRECTION and UNG (1W: -3.44% | 1M: +3.99%) CORRECTION.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency indicator); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot); XLK/XLF ratio ~3.47 (growth vs financials leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION with strong breadth: Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, VXX (1W: -5.20% | 1M: -10.44%) BELOW TREND and HYG (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.05%) RECOVERY confirm money rotating into risk. Tech and semiconductors showing relative strength — XLK (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +15.75%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +21.84%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk is the duration/credit divergence (TLT (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -1.80%) RECOVERY) and China/commodity sensitivity to monitor.
